address: Suite # 7 & 8, Mona Square, Near Kanzul Iman Masjid, Jahangir Road, Karachi.
recital: WHEREAS, the First Party agrees to sell, and the Second Party agrees to purchase, hotel accommodation packages under the terms and conditions set forth below:

paymentTerms.text: A deposit equal to **30% of the Total Invoice** must be paid upon execution of this Agreement.
The balance **70%** must be settled via the **E-Hajj portal**.
A refundable security deposit of **10,000 SAR** will be collected at the time of check-in.

termsSections.heading: Check-in / Check-out Timings
bullets: Standard Check-in time is after **18:00 (6:00 PM)**.
Standard Check-out time is before **12:00 (12:00 PM)**.
Unapproved late check-out will result in deductions from the **10,000 SAR security deposit**.

termsSections.heading: Bedding & Room Configurations
bullets: Standard Triple and Quad rooms do not exist naturally in these properties. Extra beds will be provided in twin/double bedrooms as per hotel policy.
The First Party assumes no responsibility or liability for standard bed dimensions or setup for extra bedding provided by hotel management.

termsSections.heading: Special Requests & Room Allocations
bullets: All special requests—including, early check-in, late check-out, king-size beds, connected rooms, adjacent rooms, same-floor placement, Ka’aba/Haram views, or renovated floor assignments—are strictly subject to hotel availability upon arrival.

witness: IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties hereto have executed this Agreement on the date first above written.
